name: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Ltd.
business_summary: Murugappa-group NBFC (promoters 48.9%) that is India's largest vehicle financier by profit: commercial and passenger vehicles, tractors, used vehicles, plus home loans/LAP, SME and consumer loans. Q2 FY27: revenue Rs9,271cr, PAT Rs1,630cr (+41% y/y), AUM ~Rs2.68 lakh cr (+25%, per Investywise; sources conflict), management guides 20-23% AUM growth and a Rs5,000cr QIP was approved on 2026-10-28. Q1 FY27 Stage 3 was 3.29% (net 1.81%); credit cost guidance ~1.3-1.6%. ROE 19.4%, P/E 24, 4.1x book, market cap Rs1.52 lakh cr.

revenue_mix.segment: Vehicle finance (CV, LCV, car, tractor, 2W, used)
Home loans and loan against property

exposures.mechanism: Borrowings ~Rs2.3 lakh cr (model estimate: ~85% of AUM Rs2.68 lakh cr per Investywise), ~55% floating (bank loans on repo/T-bill/MCLR) while ~80% of vehicle assets are fixed rate. +25bp on floating Rs1.27 lakh cr = Rs316cr gross; ~40% passed through to new disbursements within 12m => net ~-Rs190cr pre-tax = ~-Rs140cr post-tax = -2.3% of TTM PAT Rs6,222cr; x persistence 0.5 x EV/MCap 1.0 = -1.1; plus P/B 4.1 duration effect => -1.3. Market treats hike cycle as manageable for top NBFCs (JM/UBS/Jefferies picks Sep 2026).

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (The Hindu, Reuters headlines)
PL note: AUM growth 24%/23% FY27/28E, credit cost 1.6%/1.5% FY27 (July note)

exposures.mechanism: Bond-market funding (NCDs, ~20% of liabilities) prices off G-sec; stock trades at 24x P/E, 4.1x book (long-duration growth asset). +25bp G-sec => ~-2% on multiple at 50% pass-through to CoE; tempered because earnings growth ~25% dominates.

evidence.note: India 10y G-sec ~7.4-7.5% in Oct 2026, multi-year high (Reuters/ET headlines); Nov outlook 7.25-7.35%

exposures.mechanism: Wholesale (NCD/CP/securitisation) ~35% of funding, repricing within 3-12m. +50bp x 35% x Rs2.3 lakh cr = Rs400cr gross; 50% passed through => Rs200cr pre-tax = Rs150cr post-tax = 2.4% of PAT; persistence 0.5 => -1.2; add risk-premium effect on the multiple => -2.0.

evidence.note: PL note: AUM growth 24%/23% FY27/28E, credit cost 1.6%/1.5% FY27 (July note)

exposures.mechanism: +Rs1 lakh cr surplus eases CP/CD rates by ~10-15bp and bank MCLR/T-bill benchmarks; on ~Rs0.8 lakh cr of short-term/floating borrowings => Rs100cr = ~1.2% PAT; persistence 0.25-0.5 and cheaper capital => +0.8. Oct 2026 liquidity tightening is a current headwind.

evidence.note: India 10y G-sec ~7.4-7.5% in Oct 2026, multi-year high (Reuters/ET headlines); Nov outlook 7.25-7.35%

exposures.mechanism: Vehicle finance (CV, LCV, cars, tractors, 2W) ~65% of AUM and the bulk of disbursements (model knowledge). +10% industry vehicle volumes => vehicle disbursements +8% => AUM growth +~2.5pp/yr; over 2 years AUM +5% => PAT +~5% (ROA stable ~3%) => capitalised at 24x P/E with persistence 0.5-0.7 => +3.5. Q2 disbursements reportedly +47% y/y (Investywise, unverified).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs1,630cr +41%, Rs5,000cr QIP approved
management retains 20-23% AUM growth outlook; Rs5,000cr fundraise (CNBC TV18 headline)

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost x AUM Rs2.68 lakh cr = Rs1,340cr pre-tax = Rs1,000cr post-tax = ~16% of TTM PAT Rs6,222cr; EV/MCap ~1.0; persistence 0.5 => -8.0. Stage 3 3.29% / net 1.81% (Q1 FY27), credit cost guide 1.3-1.6%; 1.6%/1.5% FY27/28 in PL model.

evidence.note: PL note: AUM growth 24%/23% FY27/28E, credit cost 1.6%/1.5% FY27 (July note)

exposures.mechanism: Consumer/small-enterprise and personal unsecured ~6% of AUM (Rs16,000cr, model estimate); +1pp delinquency x LGD 70% = Rs113cr pre-tax = ~1.4% PAT x 0.5 => -0.7.
Semi-urban/rural ~55% of vehicle disbursements (tractor, LCV, used CV); +5pp rural growth lifts collections efficiency and disbursements; AUM +~1pp => PAT +~1.5-2% => capitalised => +1.5.
Good monsoon -> tractor/farm vehicle sales and CV freight; lowers Stage-2 rolls in rural book. +10% LPA => credit cost -5bp (Rs130cr pre-tax = ~1.6% PAT) x 0.5 => +0.8-1.0.
Infra/roads/mining drives CV, construction-equipment and LCV demand; +10% capex growth => CV volumes +~5% => same chain as F_AUTO_DEMAND (but half) => +1.5.

Pack: +2.18 per +10% HRC, t +2.8 (market beta 1.54), the strongest co-movement. Fundamental link: steel/mining/construction activity proxies CV and equipment utilisation. We shrink to +1.0 because most co-movement is cyclical beta; overlaps with F_GOVT_CAPEX / F_AUTO_DEMAND_IN (Director should de-duplicate).

Pack -0.75 (t -1.5). Diesel retail prices are administered, so the direct operator-cost channel is weak; effect via inflation/rates and CV operator margins. Indirect; kept small to avoid double-counting with Brent -> CPI -> repo.

Tightening step (higher risk weights on bank-to-NBFC lending, ECL norms for NBFCs, scale-based regulation). A 2023-style bank-NBFC risk-weight rise cost NBFCs ~10-15bp funding => ~-2% PAT; probability-weighted => -1.0.
FII holding 24.9%; market beta 1.54; +US$5bn/qtr ~ +3% Nifty => ~+4.5%, half stock-specific after demeaning.
GST cuts on vehicles/parts lift unit sales and finance penetration; +1 => vehicle volumes +3% => AUM growth +~1pp => +1.0.
Home loans/LAP ~25-30% of AUM; +10% housing sales => LAP/home-loan disbursements +4% => AUM +~1pp => +0.7.
